categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: Enterprise Systems, Consumer Electronics, and Cloud Computing. Enterprise Systems involves IT infrastructure design, installation, and implementation; Consumer Electronics provides finished IT products such as computers, mobile phones, drones, and smart devices; Cloud Computing offers cloud solutions and services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced ICT technologies including cloud management services, AI computing power integration, virtualization deployment, load balancing, and multi-cloud management platforms. It collaborates with leading cloud vendors like AWS, Huawei Cloud, and Alibaba Cloud to provide full lifecycle cloud services including consulting, migration, operation, and value-added services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad customer base including individuals, SMEs, large corporations, and government entities. Key customers include technology vendors such as Huawei, Alibaba, Tencent, HP, Apple, Lenovo, and major enterprises like HKEX, PayPal, Industrial Bank, and Luckin Coffee. The company also supports domestic Chinese brands expanding overseas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in North Asia and Southeast Asia, with over 80 offices across nine countries including China, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Philippines, Cambodia, Myanmar, and Laos. North Asia contributes about 66% of revenue, while Southeast Asia accounts for approximately 34%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily as a midstream distributor and service provider in the ICT supply chain. It distributes products from leading IT vendors through a network of over 50,000 channel partners and provides IT infrastructure services and cloud computing solutions to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding cloud computing and AI businesses, completing localization deployment in IT application innovation, and deepening cooperation with domestic brands and cloud vendors. The company invests continuously in AI solutions, multi-cloud management platforms, and digital transformation projects to drive innovation and growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of ICT hardware and finished IT products, provision of enterprise IT infrastructure services, and cloud computing solutions and services. The company recognizes most revenue at a point in time from sales, supplemented by service and support offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest ICT distributors and cloud service providers in China and the Asia-Pacific region, ranking among the top five in China's third-party cloud management services market. It holds leading positions as the largest general distributor for Alibaba Cloud and Huawei in overseas markets and maintains strong partnerships with major technology vendors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2024, the company reported revenue of HK$89.1 billion, a 21% increase year-on-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of HK$1.05 billion, up 14%. The company has shown steady growth over the past decade, especially in Southeast Asia where net profit grew 646% from 2015 to 2024. It employs over 5,600 full-time staff and maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets of HK$38.4 billion and equity of HK$8.9 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company positions itself as a trusted partner with deep customer relationships and a comprehensive product portfolio from leading global and domestic ICT vendors. It differentiates through its extensive reseller network, full lifecycle cloud services, strong AI and cloud computing capabilities, and localized IT application innovation, enabling customers to achieve efficient digital transformation and enhanced IT infrastructure performance.
